title: Brain-switch verdict contract
required_deliverables: source_proxy/decision/escalation_contract.py with verdict enum + recommend() (no provider call)

recommend() records: task shape, local attempts, formatting failures, validation failures, capability evidence, configured/unconfigured lanes, privacy class, cost class, authority required, evidence IDs
model_lanes.py + litellm_router.py consult the contract read-only (advisory)

required_gates.gate: formatting failure does not auto-recommend escalation
required_gates.command: pytest escalation test: evidence with only MODEL_FORMATTING_FAILURE -> not API_ESCALATION_RECOMMENDED

required_gates.gate: retryable local failure does not auto-recommend API
required_gates.command: pytest: retryable failure within retry budget -> LOCAL_RETRY_RECOMMENDED

required_gates.gate: bounded repeated validated capability failure can recommend escalation
required_gates.command: pytest: N validated LOCAL_MODEL_INSUFFICIENT beyond threshold -> API_ESCALATION_RECOMMENDED
test asserts no socket/subprocess/urllib provider contact during recommend(); network monkeypatched to fail-loud

required_gates.gate: no task-label escalation / no A2-A5-A9 branch
required_gates.command: ripgrep touched files for benchmark tokens in conditional context

forbidden: escalation by task label or benchmark ID
hardcoding a recommendation by prompt content
rollback: disable contract (recommend returns prior default); revert model_lanes/litellm_router consultation
